action.prompt: The task that just finished changed some files. Read the acceptance criteria in .kiro/specs/patchwork-dashboard/requirements.md for that task, check the changes against each criterion, and report which ones are met and which are not. If a criterion is not met, say so directly and say what is missing. Do not mark a task complete when a criterion is unmet.

hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, checks what changed against the acceptance criteria in that spec's requirements.md, and says plainly which criteria are met and which are not.
hooks.name: Check the task against its requirements
